questions.stem: What is the sum of the digits of the number 123?
questions.solution: The sum of the digits of 123 is 1 + 2 + 3 = 6. The other options are incorrect because they do not add up the digits properly. Adding only one digit (1, 2, or 3) gives the wrong answer. The option 3 is also incorrect as it does not account for all three digits.

hi.solution: 123 के अंकों का योग 1 + 2 + 3 = 6 है। अन्य विकल्प गलत हैं क्योंकि वे अंकों को सही तरह से जोड़ते नहीं हैं। केवल एक अंक (1, 2, या 3) को जोड़ने से गलत उत्तर प्राप्त होता है। 3 विकल्प भी गलत है क्योंकि यह तीनों अंकों को ध्यान में नहीं रखता।

questions.stem: In the Collatz sequence, what happens when the number is odd?
choices: It is multiplied by 3 and 1 is added
questions.solution: When the number is odd in the Collatz sequence, it is multiplied by 3 and 1 is added. This is the correct operation for odd numbers. Multiplying by 2 or dividing by 2 applies to even numbers, and subtracting 1 does not follow the defined rule for odd numbers.

questions.stem: In the game where players take turns adding 1, 2, or 3 to reach 21, which number should a player aim to say to ensure a win?
questions.solution: To win the game, a player should aim to say 17. This is because 17 + 4 = 21, and by saying 17, the player can control the game so that the opponent is forced to reach a number from which they cannot win. The other options do not follow this strategy and would not guarantee a win.

hi.solution: जीतने के लिए, एक खिलाड़ी को 17 कहना चाहिए। इसका कारण 17 + 4 = 21 है, और 17 कहकर खिलाड़ी खेल को इस प्रकार नियंत्रित कर सकता है कि विरोधी को ऐसी संख्या पर पहुंचना पड़े जहां वे जीत नहीं सकते। अन्य विकल्प इस रणनीति का अनुसरण नहीं करते और जीत की गारंटी नहीं देते।
